long_biography.plain_text:
Aernout Henk Tierie led the Philippine manufacturing operation of Claymount Assemblies, a Dutch-owned supplier to medical and industrial imaging companies. As president, he directed the Calamba business as it produced high-voltage cables and interconnecting devices for X-ray systems. Employees received training in production and management methods from the company's Netherlands parent.

Tierie and Louise Willemsen were named as joint applicants and inventors of a feedback device and system in a 2020 Dutch patent application. The proposed system collected operating data and returned user-facing feedback, adding product development to his documented experience in cross-border manufacturing management.
